rows.grounds: agent performing the recitation; compound of sādhaka and sattama

items.question: What quantity of mantra recitation is required of the foremost practitioner?
premises: The foremost practitioner is the agent of the prescribed act.
The act prescribed is recitation of the mantra.
The specified quantity of recitation is one thousand repetitions.
items.inference: The foremost practitioner should recite the mantra one thousand times.
items.plain_english: The best practitioner should recite the mantra a thousand times.
